entities.name: Tibor Voj
entities.description: Izzet League champion and archmage on Ravnica, husband of Lumia Voj, a master of wind magic and flight; killed in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Lumia Voj
entities.description: Izzet League champion and archmage, wife of Tibor, a master of earth and fire magic who oversaw Zimone Wola's research in the Omenpath Project.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane where the Izzet League is based.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Conflict in which Nicol Bolas's forces devastated Ravnica.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker whose forces brought devastation to Ravnica.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Mourned Tibor Voj after his death.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Began efforts to research and regulate Omenpaths through the Omenpath Project.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: Researcher of transplanar proximate disarticulation, overseen by Lumia Voj.

entities.name: Omenpath Project
entities.description: Initiative begun by Niv-Mizzet to research and regulate the Omenpaths across Ravnica.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Omenpaths opened across Ravnica.

events.summary: Tibor Voj is killed during the War of the Spark, later mourned by Ral Zarek.
events.quote: Tibor was killed during the War of the Spark

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Niv-Mizzet starts the Omenpath Project and Lumia oversees Zimone Wola's research.
events.quote: Lumia Voj oversaw Zimone Wola ’s research into transplanar proximate disarticulation.

relations.quote: They were a husband and wife team of powerful archmages
Tibor and Lumia Voj were a pair of Izzet League champions on Ravnica
He was later mourned by Ral Zarek .
